Custom Cake Boxes with Windows: Strength, Venting and Presentation

Published August 22, 2026 · Buyer guide · By BestPackFactory

Quick answer

Specify cake boxes by cake diameter and height, board strength, window size and film, base support and closure. Test with a decorated cake: check window clarity, condensation, corner crush and whether the box holds the cake during transport. Confirm food-contact materials for your market.

Decision table

RequirementTypical choiceBuyer check
BoardPaperboard 300–500 gsm or E-fluteStack and crush strength
WindowPET film, clear or frostedClarity and fogging
BaseFolding base or rigid trayCake support
ClosureTuck, lock or bandStays closed in transit

Window design is a display decision

A clear window sells the cake, but fog, distortion or scratches ruin the effect. Confirm the film grade and how the window is attached. Check whether condensation forms under the expected storage and delivery conditions.

Support the cake, not just the box

A large decorated cake needs a base that supports its weight. Confirm base stiffness, whether a cake board is required, and how the box closes without touching the frosting. Test with the real decorated cake.

Moisture is the silent killer

Cream cakes release moisture. Board strength drops when wet. Test corner crush and base integrity after a realistic delivery cycle, and consider coatings if condensation is expected.

Stacking in delivery

Confirm lid strength for stacking two or three boxes. Check that the window does not crack under pressure and that closures do not pop open during handling.

Buyer checklist

  1. Test with a decorated cake
  2. Check window clarity and fogging
  3. Verify base support and corner crush
  4. Test stacked delivery
  5. Confirm food-contact materials

Frequently asked questions

Can cake boxes be fully custom sized?

Yes, boxes are cut to the cake diameter and height; provide the largest cake size you sell.

Why does my window fog up?

Condensation forms from cake moisture; film grade, venting and ambient temperature all affect fogging. Test under real conditions.

Do cake boxes need a cake board?

Large or heavy cakes benefit from a board; confirm the box base can support the decorated cake.

What the Spec Means for Buyers

Cake boxes with windows are a structure and material spec. Kraft or white cardboard at 250–400 gsm with food-safe coatings is standard, with corrugated E-flute available where boxes are stacked. Printing is offset, flexo or digital at 1–8 colors with CMYK + Pantone matching; finishes include matte/gloss lamination, soft-touch and spot UV. The window is confirmed from your product dimensions and the die-cut position is checked against the internal fit. MOQ is 500 PCS, sampling 5–7 working days after artwork confirmation.

Frequently Asked Questions

What board weight suits a cake box?

Kraft or white cardboard at 250–400 gsm, with E-flute corrugated for stacked or heavier cakes.

Can the window position be customized?

Yes — the window is placed from your product dimensions and confirmed on the free dieline.
